page.layout: One column of running text, with a centred heading "VERSVS VI." and a verse stanza in italic below it. No marginal notes. Printed page number top left; running head top centre. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: rum, partim factioforum plaufu exhilia rati, fuffragatione◊ inflati, no modo fuae infirmitatis & donorum, quibus etiam aliij quidam a Deo inftrufti funt, obliuifca tur, nullam◊ rationem habeant: fed etia omisfis fidei hoftibus, in fidos [illegible, ~12 letters] , qui in eadem acie ftant, venenatae linguae & dentatae chartae fpicula contor queat, Antichriftianis interim in finu ue-hementer gaudetibus. Tolerabilius hoc malum foret, fi per contentionem, Chri-ftum tamen folum praedicarent. Illud au-tem modis omnibus intolerabile eft, cũ fub praetextu veritatis fua figmenta magno hiatu & conatu fpargunt. Dominu eos, quos ipfi revocare in veritatis viam eft uifum, cooertat, ac eis det idem nobifcum in Domino fentire: caeteros, qui fpu to coelu, medacijs veritatem oppugnare pergunt, cofuridat: ut cognofcat omnes, effe Deu qui omnia uideat & iudicet.
main_text.head: VERSVS VI.

p.i: Nonne omnes isti populi super eum parabolam sumet, & sermonem aenigmatiu de eo, dicent: Va multiplicanti nō sua: & quousque id faciet, & aggravabit super se

page.notes: Greek words in the line "in fidos ..." are too blurred to read reliably; left as illegible. The page number "112" and the word "aenigmatiu" are uncertain. The spelling "contor queat" and the "s"/"f" long s forms were normalised to s. The word "cooertat" and the phrase "cofuridat" are as printed (possibly "cooperatur"/"confirmat" misprints; left unchanged).
